buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of SENIOR ACCOUNTS OFFICER payable at DIRECTORATE OF TRANSPORT, SRI VIJAYA PURAM . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of SENIOR ACCOUNTS OFFICER payable at DIRECTORATE OF TRANSPORT, SRI VIJAYA PURAM . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The Bidder has to carry out the bus body repair works at the buyer' s premises i.e. Departmental Workshop of STS UNIT HUT BAY. The firm s hall arrange the machinery, tools, equipment and all other materials requir ed for the work, as well as power supply for execution of the work on the b us of STS Unit, Hut Bay.

2. The completion time for each bus is 45 days from the date of ha nding over of the bus by the department. 3. The following certificates should be provided while submitting the b ids: (a) The Bidder shall have a Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of more than INR 2,00,000 (Indian Rupees Two Lakhs only) in the la st three (3) Financial Years, i.e. 2022-23 (01.04.2022 to 31.03.2023), 2 023-24 (01.04.2023 to 31.03.2024) and 2024-25 (01.04.2024 to 31.03. 2025). The Bidder shall submit a copy of the Audited Balance Sheet an d Profit & Loss Account Statement, certified by a Chartered Accountant , as proof of the minimum Average Annual Turnover. (b) The Bidder shall have experience in Bus Body Repair and Renovation works for a minimum of the past two (2) years, i.e. 2024-25 (01.04.202 4 to 31.03.2025) and 2025-26 (01.04.2025 to 31.03.2026), in any Government Department/PSU/Autonomous Body/reputed public or priv ate organization. Proof of experience shall be furnished in the form of a certificate/work order along with a work completion certificate (with details of the period of experience and nature of work) issued by the c oncerned organization. (c) Self-attested copy of the Registration Certificate of the company/Bidd er with the appropriate authority. (d) Firm Registration Certificate of the company. (e) GST Registration Certificate of the Bidder/company. (f) Self-attested copy of the PAN Card and Bank Account details, viz. ban k name, branch name, account number and IFSC code of the Bidder/pr oprietor, for making payment. (g) Signed and attested copies of the Terms & Conditions and the Service Level Agreement of the Bid shall be uploaded by the Bidder. (h) Bidders claiming exemption under the MSE category for “Years of Exp erience” must furnish a valid MSME certificate specifically for the same or similar services. Failure to provide the relevant certificate will result in disqualification from availing the MSE exemption. 4. Failure to comply with the terms and conditions outlined above will
lead to rejection of the bid .
